facts.rationale: Replaces the current-phase-only claim with the actual iteration bounds and guards, while identifying unnamed reset fields and the visual call without unsupported semantic expansion.
facts.value: Each invocation clears EventData.xB_1, x10, x14 and x18. Selected event indices reload definitions and perform participant preparation; continuation cases restore saved timer fields when x20 > 0. Indices 9, 19, 29, 39 and 48 prepare character/costume entries from the current phase through the remaining round table. Case 35 prepares entries 0, 2 and 3 at phase zero and entries 1 and 4 whenever phase <= 1, so preparation is not limited to current-phase participants. Index 0x24 calls lbBgFlash_80021A10(0.2f). All paths set camera quake scale and create an object with the selected event callback.
